purpose: Independent exact-byte pre-freeze review of the RT21 retention successor, its checker, and its RT20-review adjudication response. This review binds a candidate-blind route-A oracle frozen before any RT21 path or byte was disclosed, recomputes the retained 55-input, EP8, D9, fixture, lease, purge, root, public-semantics, and deterministic-emission gates, and neither repairs nor applies the candidate.

scope.routeSelectionBasis: The adjudication declares an exact MappingProxyType/tuple/scalar return with all executable operations outside the returned value. No route-B fallback was admitted after review began.
scope.decisionRule: PASS requires stable exact subject and transitive-input bytes; every retained gate; the pre-frozen exact V3 inert root with recomputable hostApiBinding; seven exact separately authenticated wrappers; the complete bounded inert grammar including alias, identity, totality, and byte controls; zero active snapshot.operations consumer; and zero new blocker.
scope.authoredCheckerRole: Supplemental checker-scope evidence only. Its green 7-kind/3-edge suite and declared host-operation names do not establish the independently frozen root, implementation binding, alias, integer, byte-budget, forbidden-identity, malformed-totality, or consumer conditions.

That is predecessor-finding and review-oracle lineage, not RT21 authorship. Every RT21 conclusion was obtained from fresh exact-byte execution and probes fixed before candidate handoff rather than from the author's dispositions.

candidateBlindPreparation.statement: The route choice, root schema, inert grammar, wrapper signatures and bindings, retained commitments, mutation denominator, consumer scan, and decision rule were fixed and hashed before any RT21 candidate path, hash, byte, schema, symbol, or author conclusion was supplied.

exactByteReviewBasis.strictJson: PASS for both JSON subjects under duplicate-key, float, NaN, Infinity, and invalid-UTF-8-refusing parsing

verdict.statement: RT21 preserves the retained 55-input, EP8, D9, raw-fixture, lease, purge/custody-root, public-output-semantics, and deterministic-emission gates, and its concrete returned snapshot contains no executable object. It is rejected because the exact return is V2 plus names rather than the candidate-blind frozen V3 plus a recomputable host implementation binding; the exact wrapper oracle fails one of seven rows; the inert validator accepts alias, integer-range, byte-budget, frozen-identity, and malformed-registry controls; and the active checker retains a snapshot.operations read.
verdict.effect: RT21 remains rejected and CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED. It must not close Phase 1A, support CD-RT-5, enter E8 or OP6 bindings, or participate in architecture freeze.

blockingFindings.finding: The candidate-blind route-A oracle froze an exact schemaVersion=3, VERIFIED_SEMANTIC_RT_SNAPSHOT_V3 mappingproxy with ordered final field hostApiBinding. That binding must commit the checker source SHA-256 and seven rows of public name, implementation name, and independently recomputed implementation AST SHA-256. The exact RT21 return is schemaVersion=2, VERIFIED_SEMANTIC_RT_SNAPSHOT_V2 and ends in hostOperationIds. Its snapshot commitment therefore authenticates seven strings but does not bind those strings to exact host implementations. The frozen scan rejects the exact returned root with RT21A-SNAPSHOT-FIELDS. The exported projection wrapper also has parameters snapshot,bundle,closure instead of the frozen snapshot,evaluation_proof_bundle,semantic_capability_closure signature and unpacks the four-value implementation result, so the exact one-call marker is not returned unchanged; six of seven wrapper rows pass and this row fails.

decisiveWitnesses.semanticOutputVectors: 2/2 projection outputs still match the frozen retained commitment

blockingFindings.whyAuthoredChecksMissedIt: The authored checker treats a tuple of producer-declared operation names as the host binding and checks signatures only as contract strings. It neither compares its returned root to the independently frozen V3 schema nor commits source and implementation AST digests into the snapshot. Its projection golden checks the final three-value output, not whether the public wrapper has the frozen parameter names and exact one-call return behavior.
requiredRepair: Version the incompatible returned representation as the exact frozen V3 root rather than silently rebinding V2.

Return and snapshot-commit the closed data-only hostApiBinding with exact checker-source SHA-256 and seven independently recomputable public/implementation/AST rows; keep every callable outside the returned graph.
Expose all seven wrappers with the frozen ordered parameter names and make each route exactly once to the authenticated implementation with the frozen return behavior.

Pass the frozen root, host-binding, seven wrapper substitution, seven implementation-digest mutation, and seven invalid-snapshot-before-implementation controls under a fresh exact-byte successor review.

blockingFindings.finding: The exact candidate validator is closed over seven nominal Python value kinds but does not implement the complete frozen controls for those kinds. It silently returns when a composite identity is seen twice, admits unbounded Python integers, has no byte budget, has no forbidden-identity input, and assumes registry rows are well formed. Independently reconstructed snapshots with recomputed candidate snapshotIds are therefore accepted when candidate and rt13 alias the same mapping, candidate contains 2**80, or candidate is the exact RT20 frozen input buffer. The direct validator also accepts 67,108,865 bytes, one byte over the frozen 64 MiB budget. Malformed registries escape as TypeError or AttributeError rather than named controlled findings.

residuals.statement: A successor must implement the exact frozen route-A V3 root and host binding, close every inert-boundary control, remove the active operations read, and receive a fresh candidate-blind exact-byte review.
CD-RT-5 and Phase 1A remain blocked; no product disposition or architecture freeze follows from the retained narrow passes.
No production persistence, transaction, durability, crash recovery, concurrency, fencing, or atomicity behavior is demonstrated.

nonClaims: A green authored checker does not establish that its selected inert grammar and host binding satisfy a candidate-blind decision rule.
A clean current concrete snapshot does not prove that independently constructed, commitment-valid snapshots cannot exploit alias, scalar, byte, or identity gaps.
The post-freeze V3 translation control proves feasibility only; it is not an RT21 output, repair, application, or acceptance.
Passing retained semantic outputs does not establish exact authenticated implementation custody.

Historical predecessor operations reads may remain evidence-only, but an executable operations read in the active successor source violates route A even when its function is not called by the current selftest.
This review does not apply RT21, update a claim register, accept CD-RT-5, bind E8 or OP6, freeze architecture, or qualify a product release.
